issue.title: Initial CI/CD
issue.body:
Mobile builds and deployments are more complex than web applications. To start, we will only have a simple CI/CD pipeline.

For this ticket, establish basic status checks:
- lint and format
- unit tests run and pass
- If possible, establish a minimal build step for both Android and iOS. Don't waste a lot of time on this one yet as there might be tasks that need to be completed before this is possible.
